extracted.intended_audience: prospective attendees/applicants to the Sewanee Writers' Conference; writers considering fellowships or scholarships
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and eligibility criteria for admission, fellowships, and scholarships to the Sewanee Writers' Conference (summer writers' conference at the University of the South). Focuses on who may apply and what publication/production credentials qualify for funded awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competitive admission / formal application process
rubrics_metrics.description: Admission to the conference is competitive and is decided through a formal application process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applicants who are accepted to the conference have a portion of their expenses underwritten by the estate of Tennessee Williams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship eligibility (full tuition, room, and board)
rubrics_metrics.description: Poets, non-fiction, and fiction writers who have published at least one full-length book, whether through a legitimate small press or a major publishing house, are eligible to apply for a limited number of fellowships to cover all tuition, room, and board for the conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publication via either a 'legitimate small press' or a 'major publishing house' satisfies the published-book requirement; fellowships are limited in number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholarship eligibility (tuition only) based on periodical publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Poets, non-fiction, and fiction writers with a record of publication in periodicals are eligible to apply for scholarships (also limited in number) to cover conference tuition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A record of publication in periodicals (rather than a full-length book) qualifies an applicant for scholarship consideration; scholarships are limited in number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Playwright award eligibility (production requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Playwrights are also eligible for these awards if their work has seen production, either professional or amateur.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For playwrights, production (professional or amateur) is the credential considered for fellowship/scholarship award eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: General admission does not require publication or production
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication or production is not required for general admission to the conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even though fellowships and scholarships have publication/production-based eligibility, general (paid) admission remains open to applicants without publication or production credits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expense underwriting by Tennessee Williams estate
rubrics_metrics.description: All applicants who are accepted to the conference have a portion of their expenses underwritten by the estate of Tennessee Williams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted applicants may receive partial expense support funded by the Tennessee Williams estate; fellowships and scholarships may cover additional costs as specified above.
